text_simplified: The text speaks of the importance of the tarbiyah (upbringing) of children upon Islamic values and teaching them noble adab. It points to the necessity of habituating children to salah, adhkar (remembrances), and good conduct. It also mentions some Prophetic hadiths that encourage good treatment of children and teaching them.
